info.title: metano-typescript
info.description: TypeScript target for the Metano transpiler — CLI tool that converts annotated C# types to TypeScript

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to the C# project file (.csproj) [Required]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for generated TypeScript files [Required]

options.name: --package-root
options.description: Root directory of the consumer package (default: parent of --output) [Default: null]

options.name: --dist
options.description: Path (relative to packageRoot) where the JS build output lives (default: ./dist) [Default: @"./dist"]

options.name: --src-root
options.description: TypeScript source root relative to packageRoot (default: inferred from first segment of output path). Used to compute the dist prefix when output targets a subdirectory (e.g., src/domain/). [Default: null]

options.name: --namespace-barrels
options.description: Emit an additional src/index.ts root barrel mirroring the C# namespace hierarchy via `export namespace` blocks (opt-in; see ADR-0006).

options.name: --strip-interface-prefix
options.description: Drop the C# `I` prefix from generated interface names when it is followed by another uppercase letter (opt-in). Collisions with sibling types in the same namespace keep the prefix and emit MS0017.
